patches.title: shared draw engine resolve
patches.description: Source: n0madic/Soulcalibur2HD-recomp at 88e6cc842a7853e093e8dbab8ac053ac1ad51cc7. Toolkit changes retain the ps3recomp MIT license; see that project's docs/licensing.md. Includes the log_first.h dependency from its patch0001 and its patch0005.

patches.title: windows vulkan backend
patches.description: Source: n0madic/Soulcalibur2HD-recomp at 88e6cc842a7853e093e8dbab8ac053ac1ad51cc7, patch0006. Toolkit changes retain the ps3recomp MIT license; see that project's docs/licensing.md. Vulkan RSX backend on Windows, and its engine path batched. - The D3D12 backend has only the old live-draw path, which draws the scene into a supersampled target it never resolves (a black picture after the intro). The Vulkan backend runs the register-file draw engine, as Metal does, so it is built for Windows too with PS3RECOMP_RSX_VULKAN: vulkan-1.dll through LoadLibrary, SDL2 (static) for the window, glslang for the guest programs. D3D12 stays in the build as the fallback. - Draws, uploads, clears, target creation, depth snapshots and the GPU resolve copy (vkCmdCopyImage) are recorded into one open command buffer; consecutive draws into the same framebuffer share a render pass. Vertices, indices, constants, staging and descriptor sets come from per-batch arenas. The batch is submitted and waited on only for a readback, a present, submit_and_wait, or before a framebuffer, pipeline or render target goes away. - A present is one submission and one wait (the blit onto the display image and a centre-pixel copy in the frame's batch, the swapchain blit a second command buffer waiting for the acquire); the readback staging buffer is kept and grown. The engine's window present and the vtable path's share the acquire, blit and submit-and-present helpers. ---

patches.title: windows ppu join lifetime
patches.description: Wait for the host thread to finish before reclaiming a joined PPU slot.

patches.title: colour target feedback
patches.description: Keep a pre-draw copy when a fragment texture reads a current colour target. The requirement and snapshot timing were checked against off_rt_snapshot in JonathanDC64's ps3recomp fork, commit 61909373a2cb59f8679d8b96382e2899d656e4d0, as used by DemonsSoulsRecomp e5a7426a01e2ffebc2820965a384f59518a15b53. This implements it through the shared backend's optional colour-copy operation. The SDK and that reference implementation retain their MIT licensing.

patches.title: spu dma polling
patches.description: Keep valid repeated DMA polling alive; retain an explicit diagnostic cutoff.

patches.title: memory range reuse
patches.description: Reuse freed sys_memory ranges while preserving memory-mapper reservations.

patches.title: pad file analog input
patches.description: Allow finite analog stick holds through the opt-in PAD_FILE probe.

patches.title: spu interp profile
patches.description: Record completed SPU interpreter and microstep fallback sessions; preserve atomic snapshots.

patches.title: vp coissue operands
patches.description: Read co-issued scalar vertex-program operands before vector writes, and size scalar expressions for LIT on indexed constants.

patches.title: shared vertex program dump
patches.description: Dump the shared renderer's vertex-program words alongside optional private shader diagnostics.

patches.title: spu float mode
patches.description: Add SPU_FLOAT_MODE: SPU single-precision rules (exact) or an audit of host/SPU differences for FA, FS, FM, FMA, FMS, conversions and compares.

patches.title: callback stacks outside rsx memory
patches.description: Allocate HLE->guest callback stacks from the PPU stack region instead of fixed addresses inside RSX local memory (0xC7FF0000-0xCFFF0000).

patches.title: ppu thread lifetime
patches.description: Honour SYS_PPU_THREAD_CREATE_JOINABLE, end each started thread exactly once in its epilogue, and reuse released guest stacks.

patches.title: spurs guard reset
patches.description: cellSpursJobGuardReset restores the initial notify count, so a guard without autoReset closes again after it has released.

patches.title: cri disabled selection
patches.description: A negative SPU_CRI_IMAGE matches no context; -1 is the pure-interpretation image id and used to inherit the CRI task special cases.

patches.title: nv3089 source point and formats
patches.description: Read the NV3089 IMAGE_IN point as 12.4 fixed point with the centre-origin half pixel, and copy X8R8G8B8 sources instead of skipping them.

patches.title: engine 2d subchannels
patches.description: Keep libgcm 2D-object methods (subchannels 2-6, and 1 under GCM_SUBCH1_2D) out of the shared draw engine's NV4097 state.

patches.title: nv0039 memory transfers
patches.description: Implement NV0039 byte transfers and route a configured subchannel 1 away from both 3D renderers. Synchronize overlapping shared-renderer RGBA8 surfaces.

patches.title: renderer depth only targets and host writes
patches.description: Give depth-only passes (SET_SURFACE_COLOR_TARGET NONE) a private scratch colour target instead of replacing the surface at their stale colour offset, and reload GPU surfaces when host code writes guest memory they cover (queued from any thread). Together these fix WKC1's red cutscene flashes. Also adds opt-in diagnostics: RSX_ENGINE_DRAW_CAPTURE, RSX_ENGINE_PRESENT_LOG (stale presents, fps and GPU sync cost), RSX_ENGINE_FPS_FILE, RSX_ENGINE_RED_TRIGGER and RSX_ENGINE_WATCH_TARGET.

patches.title: spurs guard and lock line waits
patches.description: Wake job-chain walkers blocked on a job guard through a condition variable instead of 1 ms polling, and yield the host time slice when an SPU re-reads an unchanged reservation line so the holder of a contended lock can run. Without the yield a WKC1 loading burst left ~160 task threads spinning.

patches.title: spu job dispatch overhead
patches.description: Cut per-job host overhead on SPURS job chains. Cache job-image fingerprints per (address, size) behind a 33-word sample check instead of hashing up to 67 KB per dispatch; build each job directly in its context's local store and retain a copy only after a title polls a chain handle; compute FI's power-of-two scale from exponent bits (bit-identical to the ldexpf form). Adds RSX_VK_PRESENT_MODE (mailbox/immediate) and an average present GPU wait to RSX_ENGINE_PRESENT_LOG.

patches.title: spu job setup cost
patches.description: Cut per-job setup on SPURS job chains. Each job thread keeps one SPU context and clears only the local store earlier jobs on it could have written (binary end to their highest region end, plus the context and descriptor block) instead of zeroing a fresh 256 KB context per job; SPURS_JOB_ZERO_LS=1 restores the full clear. spu_task_launch_check now runs only on steps that can act: a branch to LS 0, a registered stack-reset entry, a policy context, or with a step diagnostic enabled (SPU_LAUNCH_CHECK_ALL=1 forces every step). Skipped steps still count.

patches.title: vulkan async batch flush
patches.description: Stop the frame thread waiting on the GPU when a draw batch fills. A batch whose arenas or descriptor pool are full is submitted without a fence wait, and recording continues into a second command buffer, fence, arena set, descriptor pools and deferred-destroy list; that set is waited on only when it comes round again. Every other flush (readback, present, release) still waits, and drains the spare batch too. The descriptor pool holds 8192 sets (was 1024) so a busy frame fits one batch. In WKC2's town this cut renderer blocking from about 31 ms to about 13 ms a frame. RSX_VK_FLUSH_FILE=<path> writes, every five seconds, flushes per frame and their time by source line (negative line = submitted without waiting).

patches.title: spurs job queue secondary bones
patches.description: Execute the firmware SPURS job-queue port path used for secondary-bone physics. The previously unresolved create, port-copy-push and sync imports returned success without running the queued jobs, leaving identity output matrices for the subsequent world-to-model transform. Queue/port records own copied guest descriptors and dispatch registered jobs in submission order; missing images and staging failures remain visible through error/sync/join. Use firmware job error codes and four-byte guest error-cause pointers. Provide the per-job manager control block required by the queue job CRT, rather than only the JobContext2 argument used by the existing chain path. Preserve negative staging results through the fingerprint dispatcher. The legacy compact queue API remains a separate compatibility shim.

patches.title: cache launch diagnostics
patches.description: Cache launch-time RSX audit/index and SPU job diagnostics per host thread. The disabled paths otherwise scan the process environment for each method or job. Preserve presence-based switches, descriptor dump levels, selected fingerprints and existing log budgets. Keep initialization private to each thread and use the compiler TLS spelling supported by MSVC/clang-cl or GCC.

patches.title: spu conversion scales
patches.description: Build exact power-of-two scales for SPU integer/float conversions from normal-double exponent bits. Every valid RI8 conversion scale is normal; constant immediates can fold without calling exp2 or ldexp. Preserve the original double arithmetic, saturation and NaN handling, and retain exp2 for exponents outside the normal-double range.

patches.title: context owned mfc
patches.description: Own each MFC engine in its SPU context. A fixed eight-slot registry retained stopped transient contexts, then shared one fallback engine between unrelated jobs and acquired a global lookup lock on every channel access. Context-owned storage keeps queue and tag state independent without a global limit or lock. Place it before local-store storage so selective SPURS job resets clear it.

patches.title: gcm producer wake
patches.description: Wake the FIFO consumer when completed mapped SPU DMA changes its registered producer-park command. Publish address and expected word atomically, retain the arm/reread handshake and bounded timeout, and ignore unchanged copies.

patches.title: spu depth history tls
patches.description: Keep the hot SPU host-recursion diagnostic history and settings per host thread. Preserve depth limit, environment parsing and every halt; emit at most one diagnostic report per executing host thread.

patches.title: vulkan title fps
patches.description: Show live Vulkan presentation FPS and the largest interval between accepted presentation-call completions in the SDL window title. Refresh after about one second using SDL's monotonic high-resolution clock. Count VK_SUCCESS and VK_SUBOPTIMAL_KHR, exclude failed/acquire-only/readback/guest-tick paths, and reset the window-owned counters when opening or dropping a window. Keep the existing title as a bounded base and add no worker threads or log files.

patches.title: renderer depth snapshots and frame diagnostics
patches.description: Keep sampled depth on the GPU, and add frame-pacing diagnostics. A texture reading a depth target took a GPU wait, a full readback, a CPU conversion and a texture re-upload whenever the depth was the bound target or had only been cleared. WKC2 does both every frame (its 2560x2560 shadow map and a cleared depth in the character creator). DEPTH24_D8 reads now use a snapshot retaken after the last depth write, and a cleared target can be snapshotted. The earlier creator measurement rose from about 37 to 60 presentations per second; it did not establish a 60 Hz game update rate. Patch 0068 subsequently restores the game's two-vblank semaphore pacing. Also added, off by default: - RSX_ENGINE_ZTEX_GPU=1: re-encode a Z24S8 depth read as A8R8G8B8 on the GPU (compute pass; adds a compute stage to the HLSL->SPIR-V helper). Its output still blurs WKC2's depth of field, so the guest-memory path stays default. - RSX_ENGINE_ZTEX_LOG=<file>: formats of depth targets sampled as textures. - RSX_ENGINE_PRESENT_LOG: a "fresh" count beside fps -- presents whose surface some draw wrote since it was last shown. - RSX_ENGINE_BURST_DIR=<dir> (+RSX_ENGINE_BURST_N): on <dir>/arm, write the next presented frames with present times. - RSX_ENGINE_SNAP_EVERY_S accepts fractions of a second. - PAD_FILE: a negative hold count is a hold in milliseconds, logged with start/end times to <PAD_FILE>.log.

patches.title: vulkan depth reencode
patches.description: Fix Vulkan compute bindings and depth-byte re-encoding. Compute helpers use explicit Vulkan bindings. The graphics register shifts moved the depth shader's source image from binding 0 to binding 16 while its descriptor layout still bound 0. Leave compute bindings unchanged. Mask the high depth byte just as the CPU guest-memory conversion's u8 cast does. At depth 1.0 the rounded float can become 0x1000000; an unmasked UNORM store clamped its high byte to 255 where the CPU path stored zero. Order each reuse of the shared depth-snapshot transfer buffer after the previous snapshot's read. Multiple snapshots can share a command batch. The GPU re-encoding path remains opt-in pending native visual comparison.

patches.title: gcm real flip completion
patches.description: Deliver timer flip completion only for an actual consumed FIFO or immediate display request. Resetting the polling status alone must not manufacture a flip interrupt.

patches.title: ppu watch fast path
patches.description: Keep disabled PPU memory-watch formatting and prologues off the hot path. Launch-selected environment watches retain their parsers, and live store hooks and self-arming barrier watches remain checked.

patches.title: vulkan presentation label
patches.description: Label the window presentation counter explicitly; it does not count unique guest animation frames.

patches.title: depth snapshot generation
patches.description: Require every depth snapshot to match the depth target generation, including after a zeta switch.

patches.title: spu async worker lifetime
patches.description: Claim detached SPU workers by explicit guest owner before host-thread creation; retain ownership through runner and stack cleanup.

patches.title: vulkan depth comparison
patches.description: Add native single-level 2D depth comparison sampling and per-unit mixed sampler bindings. Preserve legacy shader APIs and backend behavior when comparison capability is absent.

patches.title: vulkan texture compare direction
patches.description: Correct RSX texture comparison operand order when creating Vulkan comparison samplers. Stored texel ZFUNC reference reverses the host sampler ordering; framebuffer depth/stencil tests stay unchanged.

patches.title: gcm user command route
patches.description: Route consumed user interrupts to the registered HLE callback pump, preserving the low-level ISR route when no HLE handler is installed. Cause zero remains valid.

patches.title: texture lod bias
patches.description: Honor signed RSX texture LOD bias in the Vulkan draw engine. Preserve exact sampler identity, clamp to device bias limits, and cover decode/cache boundaries.

patches.title: vulkan direct present
patches.description: Present the guest color surface directly to the Vulkan swapchain at its own resolution. Avoid the reduced intermediate image during normal play; retain explicit diagnostics and hold behavior.

patches.title: vulkan graphics settings
patches.description: Add host Vulkan graphics preferences and a foreground-only completed-frame FPS HUD. Apply display and sampler changes after retiring GPU work; preserve original guest timing.

patches.title: d3d12 live clear rectangle
patches.description: Honor the live DirectX 12 clear rectangle and explicit zero depth. Reuse the tested D3D12 clear decoder for live depth/stencil requests.

patches.title: d3d12 display and samplers
patches.description: Integrate live DirectX display preferences and exact sampler matching. Window/fullscreen changes retire GPU references; VSync and supported tearing use DXGI. Decode signed LOD bias and apply optional anisotropy without changing point-filtered UI.

patches.title: static window titles
patches.description: Keep the game window caption static on Vulkan and both DirectX hosts. Remove per-frame/per-second title statistics; retain diagnostic and in-game counters.

patches.title: d3d12 fps overlay
patches.description: Add the optional DirectX foreground-only FPS overlay and accepted-present timing. Exclude occluded/error presents, use a one-second measurement window, and capture the composed backbuffer.

patches.title: d3d12 fxaa
patches.description: Apply the shared project-written FXAA shader on a separate live DirectX output image. Preserve guest source and alpha, fence resource/descriptor reuse and compose FPS text after filtering.

patches.title: d3d12 guest surface readback
patches.description: Materialize supported linear ARGB8 DirectX surfaces for waiting guest CPU readers. Fence GPU copies, preserve requested byte bounds and padding, reject unknown/ambiguous layouts.

patches.title: d3d12 masked color clears
patches.description: Honor partial color-clear masks in the live DirectX renderer. Use write-masked constant draws for partial RGBA clears, preserving depth/stencil and clipping.

patches.title: d3d12 shadow comparison
patches.description: Enable live DirectX depth comparison using the texture-specific operand reversal. Retain D24 precision in comparison uploads and include shadow bindings in shader identity.

patches.title: d3d12 polygon offset
patches.description: Apply live DirectX D32 polygon bias for filled guest primitives. Key pipeline state on applied integer bias and finite slope; preserve zero/disabled behavior.

patches.title: kernel lwmutex deadline
patches.description: Honor monotonic deadlines when the optional kernel mutex backend returns an early timeout.

patches.title: spu run status
patches.description: Start native SPU execution in RUNNING state, independently of interpreter fallback.

patches.title: spu fallback entry guard
patches.description: Reject interpreter or microstep entry before execution in opt-in strict verification runs. Default execution and fallback remain enabled.

patches.title: d3d12 raster depth clip
patches.description: Enable ordinary near/far clipping in live DirectX instead of the zero descriptor clamp behavior.

patches.title: d3d12 present measure opt in
patches.description: Make the DirectX benchmark presentation recorder opt-in; player mode always disables it.

patches.title: d3d12 fragment input requests
patches.description: Forward TC0..7 2D input requests in live DirectX, key both constant modes on the mask, and share decoding with Vulkan.
